homeWhyUs.title: Why Choose ZAK Trans
homeWhyUs.description: Since 2022, we have been successfully delivering projects at key oil and gas fields across Kazakhstan. Our experience, in-house technical resources, and strict adherence to quality standards make us a reliable partner for your business.
homeWhyUs.advantage2: State C&I License (Category 3) and ISO certificates
homeWhyUs.advantage3: Strict deadline compliance — obligations are fixed in the contract
homeWhyUs.advantage4: Work under an official contract with a transparent cost estimate
homeWhyUs.advantage5: Unconditional guarantee on all completed construction and installation works
homeWhyUs.advantage6: Own fleet of modern heavy equipment in excellent condition

homeReviews.title: Client Reviews
homeReviews.review1Text: The ZAK Trans team demonstrated outstanding professionalism during the tank farm construction. The work was completed ahead of schedule, and weld quality passed 100% ultrasonic testing without a single defect. We recommend them as a reliable general contractor.
homeReviews.review2Text: We have been cooperating since 2023 on process pipeline installation. We highlight their qualified personnel, own equipment fleet, and strict compliance with occupational health and safety requirements at high-risk facilities.
homeReviews.review3Text: We express our gratitude for the prompt and high-quality completion of on-site road construction. All stages, from earthworks to surface laying, were performed in accordance with SNiP standards.
homeReviews.review4Text: Excellent work on the drainage system installation at our new facility. The company's engineers accounted for all terrain specifics and proposed an optimal engineering solution. Contractual warranty obligations are being upheld.

servicesPage.title: Our Services
servicesPage.description: ZAK Trans provides a full range of construction and installation services for oil and gas enterprises. We guarantee deadline compliance, high quality standards, and strict HSE requirements.
servicesPage.seoTitle: Experience and Technology for Complex Projects
servicesPage.seoText1: Our company has its own fleet of specialized equipment and a team of qualified engineers. We take full responsibility for delivering projects of any complexity — from site preparation and earthworks to installation of high-tech equipment and facility commissioning.
servicesPage.seoText2: Our State Construction & Installation License (Category 3) allows us to act as a general contractor and deliver the full construction cycle, including preparation of all required as-built documentation.

hsePage.metaTitle: HSE / Occupational Health and Safety | ZAK Trans
hsePage.metaDescription: Our policy on occupational health, industrial safety, and environmental protection.
hsePage.title: Policy
hsePage.description: Occupational health, industrial safety, and environmental protection are the foundation of every project we undertake.
hsePage.principle1Desc: Our primary goal is to complete all works without incidents or harm to employee health.
hsePage.principle2Desc: 100% provision of personnel with modern certified personal protective equipment.
hsePage.principle3Desc: Daily pre-shift checks and scheduled medical examinations for work clearance.
hsePage.principle4Desc: Regular safety briefings (occupational safety, fire safety, environmental protection) and ongoing professional development for responsible personnel.
hsePage.cultureText1: ZAK Trans LLP has implemented and maintains an occupational health and industrial safety management system (HSE) that meets leading international and Kazakhstan standards.
hsePage.cultureText2: Before any work begins on site, all field personnel and engineering staff undergo a rigorous briefing that covers the work execution plan (WEP) and risk assessment matrices in detail.
hsePage.cultureText3: We are proud that at key facilities such as Tengiz, the incident statistics (LTI/TRIR) are maintained at a consistently zero level.
hsePage.docsDescription: Company policy, ISO 9001/14001 quality certificates, and licenses are available in the dedicated section for tender committees.

teamPage.metaDescription: Qualified specialists, engineers, and workers are the foundation of ZAK Trans's success.
teamPage.description: ZAK Trans is a well-coordinated team where every employee is accountable for the end result. Our team consists of time-tested professionals with deep expertise in working at complex oil and gas facilities.
teamPage.profileDescription: Our team is structured for rapid resolution of complex tasks. We invest in certification and clearance for every employee.
teamPage.ctaDescription: We are ready to arrange a technical specialist visit for scope assessment and initial consultation.

partnersPage.metaDescription: By working with industry leaders, we adopt best practices and raise construction quality standards.
partnersPage.description: Over the years, we have earned a reputation as a reliable contractor among the largest subsoil users and general construction companies in Kazakhstan.
partnersPage.genContractDesc: We are prepared to manage the full EPC project cycle (Engineering, Procurement, Construction). We maintain a well-developed network of subcontractors for specialized works (instrumentation, fire suppression systems).
partnersPage.genContractPoint2: Facility handover to the State Commission
partnersPage.subContractDesc: We serve as a reliable partner for major international companies. We provide qualified local personnel, equipment, and undertake heavy construction and installation works.
partnersPage.ctaDescription: We are always open to new joint projects and consortiums. Request a company presentation for your tender committee.

reviewsPage.description: Feedback on our work from industry specialists, engineers, and executives at leading enterprises.
reviewsPage.review1Text: We express our gratitude to ZAK Trans LLP for the prompt and high-quality completion of construction and installation works on the warehouse complex. All stages were completed in accordance with the work schedule.
reviewsPage.review2Text: The company proved itself as a reliable partner in the emergency pipeline section replacement project. We particularly commend the high level of on-site safety compliance (HSE).
reviewsPage.review3Text: The ZAK Trans welding crew completed assembly and piping of process units at the highest level. 100% of joints passed ultrasonic testing without a single defect. We recommend them as true professionals.

privacyPage.metaDescription: Privacy policy and personal data processing of ZAK Trans.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy Policy defines the procedures for the processing and protection of personal data of users that ZAK Trans LLP may collect during the use of the website zaktrans.kz.
privacyPage.section1Text:
1.1. Use of the Website by the User signifies acceptance of this Privacy Policy and the terms of personal data processing.
1.2. If the User disagrees with the terms of this Privacy Policy, the User must discontinue use of the Website.
privacyPage.section2Text:
2.1. This Privacy Policy establishes the obligations of the Website Administration regarding non-disclosure and protection of the confidentiality of personal data that the User provides at the request of the Website Administration when filling out feedback forms (quote request).
2.2. Personal data permitted for processing:
privacyPage.section3Text:
Data is collected solely for the purposes of:
- Establishing feedback with the User, including sending notifications, providing services, and processing inquiries and requests.
- Providing the User with cost estimates (commercial proposals) upon request.
privacyPage.section4Text: The Administration applies the necessary organizational and technical measures to protect the User's personal information from unauthorized or accidental access, destruction, modification, blocking, copying, distribution, and other unlawful actions by third parties. We do not transfer data to third parties without the user's consent, except in cases provided for by the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

aboutHero.description: A reliable general contractor for oil & gas and industrial facilities. Building infrastructure since 2022.

aboutProfile.title: Building Infrastructure for Market Leaders
aboutProfile.text1: ZAK Trans was founded in 2022. From day one, our mission has been to provide a full range of construction and installation services that meet the strict international standards of the oil and gas industry.
aboutProfile.text2: We specialize in process pipeline installation, modular building construction (office blocks, dormitories), vertical steel tank construction up to 20,000 m³, and infield road construction. Our technical base enables rapid mobilization to new oilfields.

aboutGeo.title: Geography of Operations
aboutGeo.description: We have the resources and capabilities for rapid mobilization to key oil and gas facilities in Western Kazakhstan.
aboutGeo.region1Desc: Central office and main base. Delivery of major pipeline construction and engineering systems installation projects.
aboutGeo.region2Desc: Long-term construction and installation contracts, including welding, modular building installation, and earthworks in challenging conditions.
aboutGeo.region3Desc: Local branch office and a rapid-response mobile crew for prompt fulfillment of client requests.

aboutLicenses.title: Licenses and Certificates
aboutLicenses.description: We operate in strict compliance with the legislation of the Republic of Kazakhstan and international industry reliability standards.
aboutLicenses.license1Desc: Authorizes the performance of the full range of construction and installation works.
aboutLicenses.license2Desc: Confirms high management quality, environmental safety, and occupational health standards.
aboutLicenses.guarantee1: Warranty on all types of work up to 5 years
aboutLicenses.guarantee3: Complete as-built documentation from A to Z
